from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    src = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, bg)]
    dst = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in src), max(r for r, c in src)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in src), max(c for r, c in src)
    tr0, tr1 = min(r for r, c in dst), max(r for r, c in dst)
    tc0, tc1 = min(c for r, c in dst), max(c for r, c in dst)
    for r in range(tr0, tr1 + 1):
        for c in range(tc0, tc1 + 1):
            out[r][c] = grid[r0 + r - tr0][c1 - (c - tc0)]
    return out
